Kala-Vidya Sankul Polytechnic, Vocational Training Institute of Art, Craft and Design is an autonomous Institute in Mumbai recognized by the Government of Maharashtra, directorate 0f technical, vocational & art education to address the needs of Art, Crafts and design sector through human resource development, design development and marketing.
The Institute is devoted to creating a systemized knowledge base for the craft sector. Dissemination of this resource to the craft sector right up to the practicing craftsmen is done through the Institute’s outreach programme.
The students at the Institute have created proven prototypes for most thriving fashion Industy in India.
